annotations.text:
Running screen — settled
Ring timer with a narrow schedule rail: past and future intervals shrink and fade on a thin spindle. Play/Pause/Resume merged into one toggle; next-up carried by the rail, not a separate line.

B — Tilted wheel
Rows curve away like a physical Rolodex drum. The most literal reading of "rolodex"; not picked.

C — Proportional map
A spatial map of the whole workout, tick length matching real duration, with a playhead at now; not picked.

D — Elevated cards, edge fade
The card idea again, more polished: shadows, round-number badges, edge fade; not picked.

1 — Ring timer (no rail)
The original pick, before the schedule rail was added.

2 — Full-bleed colour
The interval colour floods the whole screen — readable at a glance, even through a pocket check or bright sun.

3 — Card layout
One elevated card holds the current activity; a smaller, flatter card underneath previews what's next.

4 — Minimal typographic
Almost no chrome — a colour dot and type do the work. Next-up is one small caption line, controls are icon-only.

5 — One layout across states
The ring layout through Get ready, Running, Paused and Muted, to check the idea still reads as the workout changes.
